name: ENKI Edge Type Vocabulary Pack
description: Canonical relationship types between knowledge nodes. v0.2.0 (2026-05-11): adds 7 edge clusters — testimony (testified_against / accused_by / witnessed / denied / informed_on / alleged / named_as_associate), mention/document (mention_of / mention_in_document / has_mention / appears_in), statement (said_by / said_about / stated_in / corroborates / contradicts), beneficial-ownership (owns / owned_by / beneficial_owner_of / ultimate_owner_of / controls / shareholder_of / founded_by / trustee_of), family (spouse_of / parent_of_person / child_of / sibling_of), travel (flew_with / traveled_to / accompanied), and issue-anchor (candidate_merge_of / contradicts_in_doc / concerns_entity). Discipline: prefer fewer well-defined edges over ad-hoc ones; every edge in knowledge_edges must carry an edge_type from this vocabulary. NAMESPACE FIX (2026-07-25): added 'edgevocab' — edgevocab.predicate_seeds is now manifest-declared and its id sits outside the 'edge.vocab' namespace. Ids and the pack_source provenance string are unchanged.
